paragraphs: Abba Elazar ben Dulai — Mikvaot, chapter 5, mishnah 6.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source cites Mikvaot 5:6. In the Torat Emet 357 text on Sefaria, that mishnah does not name Abba Elazar ben Dulai; he appears in 2:10. The original locator is retained here.

Hyman cites Mikvaot5:6. Saved Torat Emet357 digital scalars for5:6 and2:9 do not name Abba Elazar ben Dulai;2:10 does. The original5:6 locator remains in the translation. These selected digital comparisons do not establish a printed error or exhaustive occurrence search. Abba is retained as supplied, without an added Rav/Rabbi title.
